sections.heading: Max Verstappen — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Max Verstappen was born on 30 September 1997 in Hasselt, and holds citizenship of Kingdom of the Netherlands and Belgium. He was given the name Max Emilian Verstappen at birth and is publicly known as Max Verstappen.
Public records name his father, Jos Verstappen and his mother, Sophie Kumpen. He is a sibling of Victoria Verstappen.
He is recorded as speaking Dutch, English and German.

sections.heading: Max Verstappen — Career and Professional Work
paras: Max Verstappen works primarily as a racing automobile driver, Formula One driver and actor.
On the team sheet, Max has been associated with Van Amersfoort Racing (from 2014 to 2015) and Scuderia Toro Rosso (from 2015 to 2016).
